subject.title: fix: A2A handoffs can duplicate message-tool replies

question: Should OpenClaw accept this waited A2A artifact-suppression boundary for message-tool mirror, transcript-only OpenClaw, and inter-session rows before merge?
rationale: The patch is focused and covered, but it deliberately changes which transcript rows can drive visible A2A replies, and automated checks cannot fully prove every live channel history shape.

options.title: Accept artifact boundary
options.body: Land after exact-head checks if maintainers agree waited A2A reply extraction must stop at transcript artifacts and message-tool mirrors for this duplicate-delivery subtype.

options.title: Require live channel proof
options.body: Keep the PR open and ask for a redacted live WhatsApp or equivalent channel run if deterministic Gateway/qa-channel proof is not enough.

options.title: Defer to broader A2A plan
options.body: Pause this PR only if maintainers want the message-tool mirror, reverse sessions_send, requester return-path, and compaction duplicate fixes coordinated together.

recommendation.title: Accept artifact boundary
recommendation.body: Land after exact-head checks if maintainers agree waited A2A reply extraction must stop at transcript artifacts and message-tool mirrors for this duplicate-delivery subtype.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the closest recent history on transcript artifact identity and adjacent run-wait internals.
